note: This file is a pure configuration file (no functions, classes, or callable code). It defines training schedule hyperparameters for ImageNet pretraining with batch size 2048 using RSB settings. No tool-use examples are applicable.
optim_wrapper: configure the Lamb optimizer with lr=0.005 and weight_decay=0.02 for ImageNet training
param_scheduler: configure a LinearLR warmup for 5 epochs followed by CosineAnnealingLR for 95 epochs
train_cfg: configure training to run for 100 epochs with validation every epoch
val_cfg: configure an empty validation setting for ImageNet pretraining
test_cfg: configure an empty test setting for ImageNet pretraining
